# package server

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/iec61850ctl/pkg/stack/server"

Package server generates libiec61850 .cfg from serialized IED JSON (export-only).

```

EncodeReadyEvent returns one JSON line for a readiness event.

### func IEDToCfg

```go
func IEDToCfg(ied *domain.IED, iedName string) ([]byte, error)
```

IEDToCfg generates libiec61850 .cfg file content from domain.IED. iedName is the MODEL name (MMS domain = iedName+LDName per libiec61850). Use "" for domain = LD name only. DA format: DA(name arrayElements type fc triggerOptions sAddr). arrayElements=0 for non-array. See [https://libiec61850.com/configuration-file-format](https://libiec61850.com/configuration-file-format) and server\_example\_config\_file/model.cfg.

### func SeedValues

```go
func SeedValues(srv *iec61850.Server, ied *domain.IED)
```

SeedValues best-effort seeds the server ValueStore from IED JSON leaf entries. Leaf refs use dot notation (LD/LN.DO.attr); store keys use MMS format (LD/LN$FC$DO$attr). The LD of a ref is an MMS domain of the model or an LDevice@inst, which maps to its domain ("InteropLD" → "InteropIEDInteropLD"), so a values file keyed by LD instance seeds a server with IEC 61850-8-1 domain names. Skips leaves without values, unsupported types, or keys that cannot be mapped.

### type RunConfig

```go
type RunConfig struct {
	SclPath    string // path to SCL/CID/ICD file (required)
	IEDName    string // IED name in SCL; empty uses the first IED
	ValuesPath string // optional path to serialized IED JSON for value seeding
	FilesDir   string // optional directory served read-only over MMS file services
	// AllowReadOnlyFCWrites accepts client writes to attributes whose
	// functional constraint IEC 61850-7-2 makes read-only to clients (ST,
	// MX, SG, SR, OR, EX). For simulators and test fixtures only.
	AllowReadOnlyFCWrites bool
	// InstanceDomainNames names each MMS domain by its LDevice@inst alone
	// ("InteropLD"), as before go-iec61850 v1.7.0, instead of the IEC
	// 61850-8-1 name (LDevice@ldName, else IED name + inst:
	// "InteropIEDInteropLD").
	InstanceDomainNames bool
	Host                string       // bind address (e.g. "0.0.0.0")
	Port                int          // MMS port; 0 binds an ephemeral port (see Running.Addr)
	MaxConnections      int          // max MMS connections (reserved; not yet enforced by go-mms)
	ReadyJSON           bool         // emit one JSON readiness event on Stdout after bind
	FixtureID           string       // optional fixture identifier for readiness JSON
	Version             string       // build/version metadata for readiness JSON
	Logger              *slog.Logger // structured go-iec61850/go-mms server logging; nil disables
	Stdout              io.Writer    // readiness JSON destination (default os.Stdout)
	Stderr              io.Writer    // human status line destination (default os.Stderr)

	// GOOSE, when non-nil, publishes the model's GoCBs on this transport
	// and exposes them over MMS (LLN0$GO$<name>). GOOSEStartDisabled
	// leaves GoEna false until a client enables publishing.
	GOOSE              goose.Transport
	GOOSEStartDisabled bool
	// SV, when non-nil, publishes the model's MSVCBs on this transport and
	// exposes them over MMS (LLN0$MS$<name>). SVStartDisabled leaves SvEna
	// false until a client enables a block.
	SV              sv.Transport
	SVStartDisabled bool
}
```

RunConfig holds options for starting the MMS server from an SCL file.
